text:
sophie: Heads-up — found a regression in the query-param shim that landed with the v3 router. It canonicalizes keys and collapses repeated params. Breaking customers who rely on case-sensitive params or duplicate keys (e.g. ?filter=foo&Filter=bar or multiple `tag` values).

sophie: Repro: curl -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/search?tag=alpha&tag=beta&Tag=legacy' --header 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -> service receives only `tag=["alpha","beta"]` and drops `Tag`.

aj: ouch. do we know which change introduced it?

lee: yeah — the shim switched to `net/url.ParseQuery` in the name-normalizer patch (simpler code path). ParseQuery lowercases keys when we later use `url.Values.Encode()` + internal normalizer. The underlying Request.URL.RawQuery still has the original bytes.

sasha: can we preserve raw ordering/casing? some clients depend on them (legacy integrations).

sophie: proposal: add a compatibility mode that preserves exact raw keys and repeated params unless tenant opts in to the normalized form. default to legacy-preserve for 2w, emit telemetry for affected tenants, then flip for new tenants after outreach.

maria: we should avoid a global toggle — use tenant-scoped flag + header opt-in. add `X-Redwood-Compat: query-param-normalize=on|off`. fallback: `REDWOOD_QUERY_NORMALIZER=legacy|normalize` env for private/dedicated installs.

lee: implementation sketch: read `Request.URL.RawQuery`, parse manually into slices without lowercasing, carry through our routing metadata. small diff:
```diff
- vals, _ := url.ParseQuery(req.URL.RawQuery)
- normalizeKeys(vals)
+ vals := parsePreserveCase(req.URL.RawQuery)
+ // parsePreserveCase returns map[string][]string exactly as seen
```

aj: +1 on header + tenant flag. Add an integration test hitting ingress (nginx) + our router to ensure proxies don't mangle. Also add a unit test for roundtrip of repeated mixed-case keys.

infra-bot: deploy queued: canary/shim-fix-preserve-query -> staging at 1715557789

maria: i'll own rollout and tenant comms. can we add a sampling telemetry event: `query_param_normalizer.affected=true` with tenant id and request path? keep sampled at 0.1% initially.

sophie: sounds good. timeline: patch + tests -> canary tomorrow, sampling + header support -> soft rollout 48h, then audit telemetry and decide cohort for flip.

aj: add acceptance criteria in PR description: e2e passing, telemetry shows <0.01% error increase, migration doc snippet for integrations.

sasha: also add a short note in migration guide about `Filter` vs `filter` semantics. customers need explicit instruction.

maria: will draft the note and the outbound email template.

sophie: thanks — i'll open the PR with the parsePreserveCase helper and test vectors. ping me if you want to pair on the integration test. :thumbsup:

lee: quick question — do we need to support percent-encoded mixed-case keys? raw query preserves encoding but parser must decode safely. i'll include that in the helper.

sophie: good catch. include decoding testcases: `%46ilter=ok` -> key `Filter`.

aj: fine to close after 2 successful canaries and docs updated.

maria: noted. i'll track rollout in the ops board.
